basis.comparison: Exact blob-content match against complete named main tree; SHA256 additionally recorded. Local origin/main snapshot, no remote fetch.

archiveRules: Byte-copy exactly one representative per SHA256 and retain every original/alias path in the mapping; do not rewrite frozen contents.
Archive all scripts as inert .source.txt, all other historical text as .txt or equivalent explicitly inert provenance. Store no executable permissions or active workflow paths.
Retain failures, unsuccessful attempts and allocation caveats. Historical result flags do not grant current acceptance.
Original absolute paths may be retained as provenance; any portable replay needs a separate relative dependency mapping and fresh authority/resource gates.
No compiler binaries, VM disks, .olean or fullrawartifact completeness claim.

outsideScopeCandidates.classification: Top-level names only. Prior prediction candidates/contracts and formal-packet original source may contain useful unique project source; hash-wire host packets frequently already encoded in committed JSON source snapshots. Compare decoded bytes before copying. r4-lexlean-bool-cases-official includes upstream compiler/build material and must NOT be blindly archived.
outsideScopeCandidates.notAssessed: No recursive content scan of these outside-scope directories; no assertion missing or represented. No other-lab or unrelated userdata enumeration beyond filtered /tmp directory names.

security.checks: Excluded sensitive filenames before read; rejected nonUTF8/NUL text and small common privatekey/GitHub/AWS credential patterns without printing values.
security.limitation: Pattern screening is not exhaustive secret detection. Parent must independently review exact proposed archive before publication.

limits: New report is inventory only. No source/repository/VM/build/compiler/native execution, deletion or existing evidence edits.

Main already contains17pendingdrafts and known product candidate LexLean outputs/current first-atom plan per prior inventory; this list covers additional unmatched text, mostly raw receipts and provenance.
Matching was exact file-byte identity; no semantic/sub-string equivalence claimed. Host harness JSON byte-string archives were outside scope and are not duplicated.
